creators.name: Holtdirk, Tobias

abstract: Analysis-first structural prediction of the megastudy's 16 x 13 treatment-effect table (outcome-level base effect + low-rank message loading + sparse assertion-match terms), every constant estimated from a train split of 11 published message experiments; Tier-1 rows synthesised backwards from the table under census quotas. Built by an autonomous LLM agent (claude-opus-5 in an agent harness) working inside an environment that scored it only on fresh respondent-halves of held-out studies with a 2-submission budget, attenuation-corrected diagnostics, and a leave-one-study-out promotion gate; no human edited any prediction. Registered team: Tobias Holtdirk, Bolei Ma; the agent sessions for this entry were operated by contributor Haiwen Huang.
approach_family: direct effect forecast by an autonomous LLM agent (analysis-first structural model fitted to prior experiments; no per-respondent simulation); backward synthesis of Tier-1 rows; single model; literature-conditioned via a vendored train split
models: claude-opus-5 (Anthropic; agent and its 14 sub-agent sessions, thinking=high, via Prime Agent 0.7.2 over Claude Code CLI 2.1.220; confirmed from every session's exec log and run.json)
